presentation: Real CLI output; JSON condensed; waits shortened. No Mission Control UI.

scenes.title: Save a preference once
scenes.subtitle: A project-scoped record with a source and a revision.

events.command:
omar --ea Writer memory save --scope project \
  --key report-format --kind preference \
  --text "Use five sections" --source "User request"

scenes.title: Share only with linked chats
scenes.subtitle: Related shares the project. Other does not.

events.stdout:
{

scenes.title: Correct it without losing newer work
scenes.subtitle: Revision 2 wins. An edit based on revision 1 is rejected.

events.command:
omar --ea Related memory edit "$memory_id" \
  --revision 1 --text "Use three sections" \
  --source "User correction"

omar --ea Writer memory edit "$memory_id" \
  --revision 1 --text "Stale overwrite" --source "Old edit"
events.stderr: Error: revision conflict; read the current memory before retrying
lines: Error: revision conflict; read the current memory before retrying
